hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.description: How we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you shop plants or request landscaping services with Mahraj Landscaping.

privacyPage.intro: At Mahraj Landscaping, your trust matters as much as healthy greenery. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect on mahrajlandscaping.com, why we collect it, and how we keep it safe when you browse, order plants, or request garden services.

sections.title: 1. Who We Are
paragraphs: Mahraj Landscaping is a plant nursery and landscaping business based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. We supply indoor and outdoor plants, trees, garden products, and full landscaping services.
lines: Nursery: Heet, Old Alharaj Road, Riyadh, KSA

sections.title: 2. Information We Collect
paragraphs: We only collect information needed to serve you well:
bullets: Details you share with us — name, phone number, email, delivery or project address, and your message when you contact us, place an order, book a consultation, or chat on WhatsApp.
Order & project details — plants or packages you choose, landscaping preferences, appointment notes, and payment records needed to complete your request.
Website usage data — basic technical details such as browser type, device type, pages visited, and general site activity, often through cookies.

sections.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
paragraphs: We use your information to:
bullets: Reply to inquiries and offer plant or landscaping advice
Process orders, deliveries, installations, and garden maintenance
Confirm appointments, invoices, and service updates
Improve our website, products, and customer experience
Share offers or tips only when allowed, or when you have opted in
Meet legal requirements and protect our business and customers

sections.title: 4. Cookies
paragraphs: Our website may use cookies to remember preferences, understand how visitors use the site, and improve performance. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings. Some features may work less smoothly if cookies are disabled.

sections.title: 5. Sharing Your Information
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information. We may share it only when needed with:
bullets: Trusted partners who help with payments, delivery, hosting, or technical support
Professionals or authorities when the law requires it
Teams involved in completing your plant order or landscaping project

sections.title: 6. How Long We Keep Data
paragraphs: We keep personal information only as long as needed for service delivery, records, legal compliance, or resolving questions. When it is no longer needed, we delete or anonymize it where practical.

sections.title: 7. Keeping Your Data Safe
paragraphs: We take reasonable steps to protect your information. No online system is perfectly secure, so we encourage you to share only what is needed and contact us if you notice anything unusual.

sections.title: 8. Your Choices & Rights
paragraphs: Depending on applicable law, you may ask us to access, update, or delete your personal information, or stop marketing messages. To make a request, message us on WhatsApp or email landscape@mahraj.com.

sections.title: 9. Third-Party Links
paragraphs: Our site may link to WhatsApp, social media, or other external services. Their privacy practices are separate from ours, so please review their policies before sharing information there.

sections.title: 10. Children's Privacy
paragraphs: Our services are intended for adults and business customers. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has shared data with us, contact us and we will remove it.

sections.title: 11. Updates to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The latest version will always appear on this page with a new "Last updated" date.

sections.title: 12. Contact Us
paragraphs: Questions about privacy? We're happy to help.
lines: Heet, Old Alharaj Road, Riyadh, KSA

termsPage.intro: Welcome to Mahraj Landscaping. These Terms & Conditions explain how our website, plant sales, and landscaping services work. By using mahrajlandscaping.com or hiring our team, you agree to the terms below.

sections.title: 1. About Mahraj Landscaping
paragraphs: We provide indoor and outdoor plants, trees, garden supplies, landscape design, installation, irrigation, and garden care from our nursery in Riyadh.
lines: Nursery: Heet, Old Alharaj Road, Riyadh, KSA

sections.title: 2. Using Our Website
paragraphs: Please use our website respectfully and lawfully. Do not attempt to disrupt the site, misuse content, or access private systems. We may update website information at any time.

sections.title: 3. Plants, Products & Services
paragraphs: Photos and descriptions are a helpful guide. Because plants are living products, size, color, and shape can vary naturally.
Landscaping plans and prices depend on your space, goals, and site conditions. Final scope is confirmed in a quote or agreement.
We may update, limit, or discontinue products or packages when needed.

sections.title: 4. Orders, Quotes & Payments
paragraphs: An order or accepted quote is a request to purchase, subject to availability and our confirmation.
Prices are those shown or quoted at confirmation, unless we agree otherwise in writing.
Payment details appear at checkout, on your invoice, or in your service agreement.
For custom landscaping, a deposit or staged payments may be required before work starts or continues.

sections.title: 5. Delivery, Installation & Site Access
paragraphs: Delivery and installation dates are estimates unless confirmed in writing.
Please provide clear access, parking details, and any permissions needed for safe work.
Weather, access issues, supply delays, or events beyond our control may affect timing.

sections.title: 6. Cancellations & Changes
paragraphs: Tell us as early as possible if you need to cancel or change an order. Fees may apply if plants are already reserved, materials purchased, or work has begun. Completed custom landscaping work is generally non-refundable except where required by law.

sections.title: 7. Plant Health & Care
paragraphs: We aim to supply healthy plants. Any guarantee offered will be explained at purchase or in your agreement and usually depends on proper watering and care.
Guarantees typically do not cover neglect, incorrect watering, pests after delivery, extreme weather, or changes made by others.
If a plant arrives damaged or unhealthy, contact us quickly so we can help with a fair solution.

sections.title: 8. Website Content & Branding
paragraphs: Text, images, logos, and designs on our website belong to Mahraj Landscaping or our licensors. Please do not copy or reuse them without written permission.

sections.title: 9. Limitation of Liability
paragraphs: To the fullest extent allowed by law, we are not responsible for indirect or consequential losses. For any claim related to a product or service, our responsibility is limited to the amount you paid for that specific item or service.

sections.title: 10. Privacy
paragraphs: How we handle personal information is explained in our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 11. Governing Law
paragraphs: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Disputes are handled by the competent courts in Riyadh, unless applicable law requires otherwise.

sections.title: 12. Changes to These Terms
paragraphs: We may update these Terms & Conditions when needed. The latest version will be posted on this page. Continued use of our website or services after an update means you accept the revised Terms.

sections.title: 13. Contact Us
paragraphs: Need clarity on anything in these Terms? Reach out anytime.
